user.title: Calendar snapshot receiver
user.description: Create a read-only receiver for selected original calendars. Publish Snapshot v1 using the authenticated admin service belovodie_calendar_bridge.publish. Last successful snapshots remain available through source failures; stale and exported-window attributes show their coverage.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one calendar snapshot receiver is allowed.
abort.already_configured: The calendar snapshot receiver is already configured.

publish.name: Publish calendar snapshot
publish.description: Publish a validated Snapshot v1 using administrator authentication. Failed sources retain their last successful events and exported window.

snapshot.name: Snapshot
snapshot.description: The complete Snapshot v1 JSON object produced by the native Mac bridge.
